This '''list of [[fossil]] [[fishes]] described in 2016''' is a list of new [[taxa]] of [[Agnatha|jawless vertebrates]], [[placoderm]]s, [[Acanthodii|acanthodians]], fossil [[cartilaginous fishes]], [[bony fishes]] and other fishes of every kind that have been [[binomial nomenclature|described]] during the year 2016, as well as other significant discoveries and events related to [[paleontology]] of fishes that occurred in the year 2016. The list only includes taxa at the level of [[genus]] or [[species]].
